articles.title: Oracle stock pops 10% on forecast for 35% average revenue growth through 2030
articles.summary: Oracle shares jumped on Wednesday after the software company issued a revenue forecast of $225 billion for fiscal 2030, implying 35% average annual growth, and said it will limit additional fundraising over that stretch to $20 billion. Analysts polled by LSEG expected growth of 8% in fiscal 2027, followed by significant acceleration over the next two years.

articles.title: Fed holds rates steady despite concerns over inflation
articles.summary: In a widely expected decision, the Federal Open Market Committee kept the overnight funds rate in a range between 3.75%-4%, where it has been since the central bank approved a quarter percentage-point increase in September. Fed officials consider political independence to be a cornerstone of the central bank, but some observers have speculated that officials won't want to raise rates this close to an election.

articles.title: Ford Motor is set to report earnings after the bell. Here's what Wall Street expects
articles.summary: DETROIT — Ford Motor is set to announce third-quarter earnings after the markets close Wednesday. A main focus for investors will be Ford's F-Series pickup trucks, including its crucial F-150. The automaker has been recovering from supplier issues that affected truck production for much of the past year, but experienced a disruption in F-150 manufacturing due to a separate, unrelated supplier problem toward the end of September.
